svg.font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A ring of ten positions like a lock dial, one per digit, with a stack of sample images of that digit at each position. A single circular arrow inside the ring runs clockwise from zero through nine and back to zero. An arrow leads out of the ring into a box labelled REGIS, and a further arrow leads out to the right.
svg.text: The data: a cycle of unpaired samples
A bag of samples from each marginal with no connections between them
